observed_behavior: A second native thread/archive call after successful archival returned no rollout found for the same thread.
expected_behavior: A retirement retry after an unknown archival acknowledgement recognizes the already archived actor and continues cleanup without repeating archival.
causal_mechanism: The installed native archive operation removes the active rollout path; repeating the mutation cannot locate that path. The archived inventory still identifies the same actor.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Retrying a non-idempotent external mutation from a durable pending intent without reconciling authoritative external state.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: A successful mutation with a lost acknowledgement appears pending locally, while its original mutation precondition no longer exists.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: An unknown archival acknowledgement is reconciled against the exact original native identity before any repeated archive mutation or resource release.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Query paginated archived inventory scoped to the physical checkout. If the original thread is already archived, advance the retained journal; otherwise archive that same actor. Preserve ownership on unknown or failed outcomes.

applicability_conditions: An archive acknowledgement can be lost after external mutation.
confirmation_evidence: Native retirement test first acknowledged archive, then failed its second archive call with no rollout found.
Real PostgreSQL regression simulates lost archive acknowledgement and completes cleanup after inventory reconciliation, with archive count exactly one.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-campaign-store.integration.test.ts: worker retirement revokes native ownership and fences checkout release through restartable cleanup
tests/rolling-codex.integration.ts: live worker acknowledges retirement, becomes idle and reconciles archival of the same actor
